title: Black
summary: Black is an AI-first programming language designed to be equally approachable to human programmers and autonomous coding agents.

showcase.alt: Gold line drawing of three slanted pillars crossed by a descending stroke, inside a stepped Art Deco frame over a ruled grid of proof marks

artifact.alt: White’s pipeline in four stages. Front end: parse, resolve imports and names, check unused bindings, types and exhaustiveness. Proof of fit: interval reasoning, every integer result fits its type, every divisor nonzero, each cast proved, contract obligations. Core: elaborate into Core, validate Core by re-deriving the evidence, bind entry points or a native boundary. Back end: emit textual LLVM IR, compile with clang-19, producing an executable or a shared library that a C host loads.
